project_mode.description: Whether Diffmogger should create a fresh target project or integrate automation into an existing project.

automation_must_never_do.description: Non-negotiable actions the automation must never take.

env_access_policy.description: Whether automation may directly open local .env files, or may only rely on project commands that load env values normally.

additional_context_files.description: Optional project context files or copied target-relative context paths such as PDFs, research notes, or design docs. Do not include secrets.

write_worker_agents_allowed.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Diffmogger always allows bounded write-capable worker agents; the main agent still decides per run whether to use zero or more workers.

max_write_worker_count.description: Maximum number of write-capable worker agents the main agent may spawn in one run. Values are capped at 10 by the scaffold.

write_worker_guidance.description: Project-specific guidance for optional write workers. Keep this generic, bounded, and focused on disjoint ownership and main-agent integration.
write_worker_guidance.default: Write workers are optional and should be used only for large, well-planned changes with disjoint file or module ownership. Prefer fewer workers when the change can be done clearly by the main agent.

parallelism_budget_overrides.description: Optional advanced local concurrency overrides by budget scope. Omit for Diffmogger's conservative defaults derived from worker settings.

parallel_execution_mode.description: Execution DAG scheduler policy for automatic ready-wave planning. Aggressive mode may launch compatible cross-ticket scope, write, review, and validation waves while keeping integration serialized.

symbol_graph_languages.description: Languages used for symbol-level graph extraction. File-level graphing remains the fallback signal when parsing is unavailable or a language is omitted.

parallel_write_min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence for a DAG write node to enter a parallel write wave.

parallel_write_direct_confidence.description: Confidence expected from direct file/path mentions or exact symbol-owner matches before a DAG node is treated as a direct write candidate.

max_parallel_write_workers.description: Maximum write DAG nodes the scheduler should include in one compatible write wave.

max_parallel_scope_workers.description: Maximum scoping/read-only DAG nodes the scheduler should include in one compatible scope wave.

multi_role_automations_allowed.description: Legacy compatibility mirror. Diffmogger now always scaffolds the multi-role DAG scheduler; new intakes should omit this flag.

automation_role_profile.description: Canonical owner-role profile for the execution DAG scheduler.

automation_checkpoint_commits.description: Whether the integrator may create local automation-authored checkpoint commits before applying queued role patches.

campaign_mode.description: Whether the DAG scheduler should run a bounded seeded/imported ticket queue or continue drafting/enqueuing new generic tickets as an ongoing campaign.

ticket_run_file.description: Legacy target-relative Markdown ticket import path. Leave empty for dashboard-backed SQLite ticket campaigns.

ticket_run_seed_tickets.description: Optional seed tickets used when initializing the dashboard-backed SQLite ticket queue for bounded or ongoing campaigns.

ticket_completion_notify.description: Whether bounded campaign finalization should send an Apprise notification when notifier mode is configured or record a fallback outbox entry.

ticket_generation_complexity.description: Coverage breadth hint for low-cortisol full-scope ticket generation. This is not a ticket-count range.

ticket_generation_decomposition_brief.description: Compact full-scope decomposition brief used to generate the dashboard-backed SQLite ticket queue.

ticket_generation_scope_groups.description: Compact scope groups used as coverage requirements for full-scope seed ticket generation.

ticket_generation_quality_warnings.description: Compact quality warnings from low-cortisol ticket generation, such as under-decomposition warnings.

ticket_generation_refinement_needed.description: Whether the low-cortisol ticket quality gate requested a refinement pass.

ticket_generation_refinement_passed.description: Whether the final low-cortisol ticket queue passed the coverage-oriented quality gate.

ticket_generation_scope_surface_floor.description: Derived lower-bound count of reviewable surfaces from the decomposition, used only for under-decomposition diagnostics.

multi_role_allow_remotes.description: Whether dashboard-managed local-only multi-role DAG jobs may set MULTI_ROLE_ALLOW_REMOTES=1 when the repo has configured git remotes. This does not permit pushes, fetches, pulls, or remote configuration.

optional_mcp_servers.description: Optional project-scoped MCP servers to configure for role-scoped Codex automation. Omit this field to enable all supported MCPs by default; set an explicit empty array to opt out. Missing or unauthenticated MCP servers remain advisory and must not block overnight runs.

meaningful_deliverable.default: A runnable, verified change that improves the product or developer workflow.

beyond_mvp.description: Legacy field name for the neutral long-run direction used by continuous-improvement scaffolds. Ticket campaigns may leave this empty.
beyond_mvp.default: Continue improving core value, demo quality, integrations, and automation reliability.
